figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online') SELECT CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END segment,COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) customers,COUNT(*) orders,SUM(net_cents) net_cents,ROUND(1.0*SUM(net_cents)/COUNT(*),2) avg_order_cents FROM a WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END ORDER BY segment

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online')
parts.note: 先把名为 a 的中间结果算出来，供后面的查询引用。

parts.label: 取数
parts.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END segment,COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) customers,COUNT(*) orders,SUM(net_cents) net_cents,ROUND(1.0*SUM(net_cents)/COUNT(*),2) avg_order_cents
parts.note: 输出查询需要的列与计算表达式。

parts.label: 来源
parts.note: 从 a 读取输入数据。

parts.label: 筛选
parts.note: 仅保留满足 order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' 的行。

parts.label: 分组
parts.sql: GROUP BY CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END
parts.note: 按 CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END 把行归入各个分组。
